effects: Takes exactly `assets` USDC from the signer and sends it to the vault (VaultV2.enter, safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
Mints vault shares, worth previewDeposit(assets), to `onBehalf`, which may not be the signer (createShares(onBehalf, shares)).
The vault then puts the USDC into its liquidity adapter. This moves none of the signer's assets.
formats.shown: Deposit 1 USDC for <onBehalf>, with the vault share ticker and the share recipient as fields; the number of shares minted is not shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown; the vault works it out from its share price in storage.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);` reads totalAssets and totalSupply from storage. The descriptor shows only `assets` and a raw 'Share ticker' constant.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. You could relabel 'Share ticker' as 'Shares received' to make clear that shares come back.

findings.title: deposit: the label 'Deposit asset' sits on an amount, and 'Share ticker' is a raw constant with no amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit fields: label 'Deposit asset' on path `assets` (tokenAmount); label 'Share ticker' with value $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker (raw).
findings.fix: Rename them to 'Amount' and 'Receive shares of'. You could also name the vault in the interpolatedIntent, for example 'Deposit {#.assets} into skyMoneyUsdcRiskCapital for {#.onBehalf}'.

cases.notes: 1 USDC left the signer and is shown exactly. The shares were minted to 0xdEaD (signer null), and both the screen and the reader got that right.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns previewWithdraw(assets) vault shares from `onBehalf` (deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)).
When the signer is not `onBehalf`, uses up that many shares of onBehalf's allowance to the signer (allowance[onBehalf][msg.sender] -= shares).
Sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver` (safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)).
May pull liquidity from the adapter first. This moves none of the signer's assets.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly X USDC to <receiver>, with Owner = onBehalf; the number of shares burned is not shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is not shown; it comes from the share price in storage.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)`, then deleteShares(onBehalf, shares). Case 1: 95065.142649005895003744 skyMoneyUsdcRiskCapital left the signer (signer out) and the screen shows no share amount.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. You could add a constant field such as 'Burns: skyMoneyUsdcRiskCapital shares' so the signer knows shares leave.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent does not say that the owner's shares are burned or allowance is spent when the owner is not the signer.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `if (msg.sender != onBehalf) { allowance[onBehalf][msg.sender] = _allowance - shares; }`. interpolatedIntent 'Withdraw {#.assets} to {#.receiver}' leaves out onBehalf, which appears only as the field 'Owner'.
findings.fix: Put the owner in the sentence: 'Withdraw {#.assets} from {#.onBehalf}'s shares to {#.receiver}'.

cases.notes: The USDC that arrived matches the screen exactly. The reader guessed that shares leave but had no amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `onBehalf` (deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)).
When the signer is not `onBehalf`, uses up `shares` of onBehalf's allowance to the signer.
Sends previewRedeem(shares) USDC to `receiver` (safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)). The calldata has no minimum for this amount.
formats.shown: Redeem N skyMoneyUsdcRiskCapital to <receiver>, with Owner = onBehalf; it names neither the asset received (USDC) nor its amount.

findings.title: redeem: the USDC amount received is not shown; the vault works it out from its share price in storage.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. Case 2: 4,564,128.923757 USDC came in to the signer and no amount is on screen.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says that USDC is the asset received, so the blind reader had to guess.
findings.evidence: interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}'. No field names the underlying token, although metadata.constants.underlyingTicker = 'USDC'. Case 2 reader: 'Some underlying asset (likely USDC) ... the screen does not state the asset or amount'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Redeem {#.shares} for USDC to {#.receiver}' or add a field 'Receive' with value $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker.

cases.notes: The shares burned match the screen exactly. The reader expected USDC to arrive but had neither the asset nor the amount.
